svg.title: Which documents the archive mirrors
svg.desc: A run first checks that Paperless has every tag to mirror of the settings; without one of them, the export stops before a file changes. Then it asks three questions of every active document. A document in the inbox of Paperless, while the settings skip the inbox, stays out of the archive, and so does a document with an excluded tag. When the settings name tags to mirror, a document without any of them stays out as well. Every other document is mirrored. A document that stays out loses its copy in the archive, within the batch size.
